data.body: A template is a page blueprint: slots an agent fills to stamp out a page with the right structure.

Body fields

  • tracking
  • name (required)
  • description
  • whenToUse
  • scope
  • appliesTo (required)
  • slots (required)

Patch operations

  • set_template_meta
  • upsert_slot
  • move_slot
  • remove_slot
  • set_tracking

This reference is generated from the live object_contract. If it disagrees with the contract, the manual is wrong and the drift guard fails the build of it.

Worked example

tpl_object_reference defines an introduction slot and repeatable detail slot. It stamped the editorial_voice reference page and recorded template provenance without creating a live inheritance link.

Lifecycle note

Templates are recipes; PageTypes remain structural law. Required slots need usable blueprints before the recipe is publish-ready.
